title: flatRoutes
summary: Discover a flat route table at build time.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: directory is the path to the routes folder.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A Promise<RouteFile[] | Error>. Each item contains a route pattern and module filepath.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Node filesystem access is required; do not import this entry into browser components. Only immediate flat files and route folders are discovered. Invalid patterns and conflicting parameter shapes return Error values. The Vite plugin normally calls this for you.

sections.title: Literal dots and route identity
sections.body: Dots separate URL segments. Escape a literal dot as [.]: robots[.]txt.ts or robots[.]txt/route.ts maps to /robots.txt; feeds.rss[.]xml maps to /feeds/rss.xml. File-route paths and identity come from filenames. Do not export id or routePath: the Vite plugin rejects those overrides. Target generated route data with its path and root data with root. Explicit IDs remain available in manually defined route arrays. Other bracket escapes and optional segments are unsupported.
